text.title: Agency Discovery Call Scorecard Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable scorecard signals to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml. Every leaf references a rule id.

decision-tree.root-question: Does the agency run more than one discovery call per week, with a written ICP to score fit against?

conclusion.verdict: one call a week does not need a comparative score; qualify by judgement and revisit at higher volume
write the ICP criteria first; fit anchors cannot be observable without them

branch.question: Does the rubric contain fit, budget, urgency and decision_maker with weights summing to 1.0 and no axis above 0.5?

conclusion.verdict: add the missing axis or renormalise weights; bump rubric version

branch.question: Is every anchor an observable fact (currency range, calendar window, role or confirmed authority, ICP criteria met)?

conclusion.verdict: replace adjective anchors before scoring any call

branch.question: Is decision_threshold a single number strictly inside [0, 100] with a stated advance/reject rule?

conclusion.verdict: rubric is usable; score each call within 24h with an evidence note per axis

text.example: calls_per_week=4 -> written_icp=true -> four_axes_and_weights_valid=true -> anchors_observable=true -> single_threshold=true -> conclusion ref=r-scored-within-24h-with-evidence
